attr.title: Marryampic2
attr.desc: A memory/pairs card game with an audio twist: find matching card pairs, either the classic way or by first hearing a sound and finding the pair it belongs to. Ships with 49 cardset themes, from the official Marryampic2 sets to the full legacy Marryampic I catalog.
attr.inst: Ready to run, no additional files needed. Cardsets are bundled and extracted automatically on first launch.
